changes: Replaced extracted top-level definitions with static local module imports; retained the FactoryAuthPlugin entry point and narrowed _internal to protocol helpers without importing disabled identity adapters.

The refresh lock, renewed-token cache and whoami timestamp cache remain in the original single FactoryAuthPlugin invocation scope, shared by all its accounts and loaders; the synthetic session ID and message metadata were removed.
Forwarding now uses only protocol, tool-schema, Fast Mode and request-size helpers; it does not call droidBody, anthropicBody, sanitizeBody or any client-context helper.

Every forwarded upstream 403 is returned as the original Response without reading its body, rebuilding its error, adding sign-in headers or retrying under another organization; a 403 after the permitted 413 size retry is preserved too.

Removed synthetic factory-cli, fixed OpenAI organization, routing-source and placeholder Anthropic key metadata; real caller client headers are preserved and only loader placeholder API keys are stripped.

Extracted existing provider identity, endpoints, OAuth client identity and refresh timing constants without changing values. Marked the retained Droid VERSION constant as historical reference only; default requests do not advertise that client build.

Extracted existing model metadata, promotions, prices and catalog builders; model arrays and lookup maps remain single module instances. Updated the sampling compatibility comment to reference the protocol-only openaiBody helper.

Extracted existing FactoryStatus, refusal classification, upstream identifiers, error messages and response helpers. The historical explain helper is no longer exported from the entry or used to rewrite 403 responses; its generic wording now accurately says identity rewriting and access-restriction bypass are disabled.

Extracted existing token, WorkOS device sign-in, organization reconciliation and API-key helpers; stateful refresh coordination remains in index.mjs. factoryHeaders now supplies only account bearer authentication and selected organization, without fabricating Factory CLI client, version or User-Agent headers.
Extracted existing usage windows, timestamp and currency formatting and standard_only option without changing their bodies or values.
Retained the extracted upstream client-context routines as licensed historical reference only; default Factory forwarding intentionally does not import, execute or expose them.

The retained reference uses a static JSON import in place of readFileSync(new URL(..., import.meta.url)); its original JSON values, filtering and FALLBACK_PHRASES are unchanged, but neither JSON nor fallback participates in default forwarding.
Added an explicit reference-only header; no default identity replacement, reminder rewriting, compaction rewriting or refused-phrase Unicode/JSON encoding remains connected.

Retained Fast Mode and attachment-size handling. Replaced droidBody/anthropicBody with protocol-only openaiBody/anthropicProtocolBody, limited to unsupported sampling or streaming-option removal. geminiBody now changes model/stream/systemInstruction shape only and preserves all text and part order. Removed promptOpenings, droidChat, sanitizeBody and every client-context import; no Droid preamble, identity substitution or phrase escaping is performed.
Updated only the files list to include all split runtime modules, LICENSE and SOURCE.json and omit the uncopied README.md; package name, version and entry point are unchanged.

intentionallyDisabled.feature: Automatic Droid identity and caller-text rewriting
details: No Droid fixed-line insertion, identity substitution, billing-line removal or system/history/tool-text rewriting.
client-context.mjs, client-phrases.json and FALLBACK_PHRASES are retained as reference only and unreachable from the entry dependency graph.
No refused-phrase Unicode escaping, JSON-string wrapping, reminder rewriting or compaction rewriting.

intentionallyDisabled.scope: Model forwarding and shared authenticated Factory headers
details: No synthesized Factory CLI identity/version/User-Agent, session/message/routing-source identifiers, OpenAI organization marker or Anthropic placeholder key.
The caller's real client headers stay intact; account authentication, selected organization and model-provider routing remain active.
The upstream WorkOS device-flow client_id is retained as its OAuth protocol parameter, not copied into model-request identity metadata.

intentionallyDisabled.scope: Every upstream model HTTP 403, including one received after a 413 size retry
details: Status, statusText, headers, original error code/message and response body stream are returned unchanged.
No refusal-text parsing, new permission_error envelope, added explanation, sign-in header or organization retry is performed.
Refresh coordination and billing-usage organization reconciliation remain account-management functions; they do not retry a refused model request.

defaultSupportRestrictions.policy: Forward caller identity and content faithfully; Factory's actual client, plan, organization, region and usage-policy decisions determine access. There is no compatibility promise based on hiding refused text or impersonating Droid.
thirdPartyScenariosNotPromised: Claude Code or Claude Agent SDK identity/system prompts, attribution/billing text and generated environment/model/skill reminders rejected by Factory.
pi identity/system prompts and compaction or branch-summary text rejected by Factory.
Codex, Grok Build or other non-Factory clients on subscription routes that require Factory's own client identity or metadata.
History, user messages, tool output, tool arguments, restored skills or file text containing client phrases that Factory rejects.
defaultSupportRestrictions.nativeFactoryRequests: Requests already carrying the caller's genuine Factory/Droid identity and client metadata are not replaced or fabricated; only declared protocol, schema, Fast Mode and request-size adaptations remain.
defaultSupportRestrictions.verification: Static dependency/source checks and pure Bun compilation only; no runtime, credential, test or upstream-request validation.
